name: LDAP Authentication
description: Authenticate your Jellyfin users against an LDAP database, and optionally create users who do not yet exist automatically. This build adds a fix so password changes work against Active Directory (unicodePwd).
overview: Authenticate users against an LDAP database (with Active Directory password-change fix)

versions.changelog: Fix login and password-change failure when the Jellyfin username differs from the LDAP username only by case (upstream #201). Includes the Active Directory unicodePwd password-change fix from 23.0.1.0/24.0.1.0. (Jellyfin 12)

Active Directory fix: "Allow Password Change" now works against AD (unicodePwd written as quoted UTF-16LE). Set LDAP Password Attribute to unicodePwd and delegate Reset Password to the bind account. Otherwise identical to upstream. (based on upstream master/v24 for Jellyfin 12)

Fix login and password-change failure when the Jellyfin username differs from the LDAP username only by case (upstream #201). Includes the Active Directory unicodePwd password-change fix from 23.0.1.0/24.0.1.0. (Jellyfin 10.11)

Active Directory fix: "Allow Password Change" now works against AD (unicodePwd written as quoted UTF-16LE). Set LDAP Password Attribute to unicodePwd and delegate Reset Password to the bind account. Otherwise identical to upstream. (based on upstream v23 for Jellyfin 10.11)
